name: train_rear
question: A Vek attack on the train's rear tile (its ExtraSpaces tile) kills the train in game; the engine places multi-tile pawns on their main tile only.
mission: Mission_Train or Mission_Armored_Train, a player turn with the train still running
observe: The Hornet stands left of the train's rear tile and stings it.
Game: does the train take the hit (and die at 1 HP)? Engine: the rear tile is empty, so nothing happens there.
If the tile left of the rear is blocked, edit dx/dy (e.g. dx 1) and rerun.
